original_question: (V. M. Kopytov, N. Ya. Medvedev). Are there order automorphisms of Dlab groups that are not inner automorphisms?
target_in_paper: Problem 21.149 in Section 21, "New Problems (21st issue, 2026)": "Are there order automorphisms of Dlab groups that are not inner automorphisms?"
correct_elements: Your draft already captures the exact authors, the exact object class (Dlab groups), and the precise existence question contrasting order automorphisms with inner automorphisms. It is essentially a verbatim restatement of Problem 21.149.
missing_details: For exact identification, the statement should be located as Section 21, Problem 21.149, page 182.
To make it stand-alone, the existential quantifier should be made explicit by naming a Dlab group G.
The phrase "order automorphism" should be unpacked as an automorphism of G that preserves the chosen ordered-group structure on G.

refined_question: Does there exist a Dlab group G together with an order making G an ordered group and an automorphism alpha: G -> G that preserves this order but is not inner; that is, alpha is not of the form alpha(x) = g x g^{-1} for some fixed g in G and all x in G?
